Definition: from G4253 and G3143; to be a witness in advance i.e. predict:--testify beforehand.
BiblicalUsage: Promartyromai means to testify beforehand, to witness in advance. Peter uses it once: the prophets searched what the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ and the glory that should follow.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the prophets testified to sufferings and glory together, and the cross and the crown were always one story.
